description: "Gather the true strength of Apocrypha as protective tentacles rise from the Abyssal Sea around you. The tentacles form a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff60|r% of all damage for |cffffff10|r seconds, up to a max of |cffffff53426|r damage, scaling off your Max Health.\n\nWhen the shield collapses you lash out, dealing all of the damage absorbed as Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters over |cffffff10|r seconds."
